summary: A mixed day dominated by Reliance's $1 billion securitization push and FSSAI beverage regulation challenges. Legal activity includes Supreme Court hearings on Election Commission leadership while retail faces festive season dynamics and regulatory headwinds.

bullets.text: Reliance plans second $1 billion bond securitization deal in three weeks, ahead of RBI decision.
Red Bull approaches Delhi High Court to dispute FSSAI's ban on energy drink labeling ahead of compliance deadline.
Supreme Court to hear plea against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar next week.
High gold prices drive Indian jewellery buyers toward silver this festive season as middle-class demand shifts to affordable alternatives.
Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases secures Rs 481 crore BHEL contract for 1,200 TPD cryogenic Air Separation Unit; shares rise 5.10%.
